title: Arrival at the dispatch configuration
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k>0$ work tapes, let $e$ and $z$ be states of $C$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. After exactly $2|x|+2$ steps, the wrapper machine started on $x$ is in state $2$ of its three setup states, with its input head at the first input cell, $x$ stored on work tape $0$, all other work tapes blank, all work-tape heads at cell $0$, and its output empty.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$C$ has a positive number of work tapes
replaced:
Let $C$ be a finite machine with at least one work tape and designated entry and
exit states, and let $x$ be an input. After exactly $2|x| + 2$ steps from its
initial configuration on $x$, the decider wrapper of $C$ is in the dispatch seam
configuration: the dispatch state, $x$ on tape zero, every other work tape blank,
and all heads at their starting positions.
